engine_assumption_note: Snowflake. 'MEMBER:' || nullif(trim(X),'') is NULL when X is blank and the load DROPS a NULL key, so every null_on_blank_row block becomes an explicit COUNTED reject whose predicate is the exact boolean complement of the emit predicate. An absent EAV label materialises as '' and not NULL, so every ladder operand is written nullif(trim(<operand>),''). The SAME rule is applied either way (s9.8).

builder_decisions.decision_note: The reference_decode gate defaults to REFUSING the row. No reference-decode master exists anywhere in this bundle, and the directive says loading the raw code into a label attribute is WRONG DATA that every gate passes.
builder_decisions.cost_note: 3 rows (SAT_PARTY_ORGANISATION_PROFILE 'Industry Description' and SAT_PARTY_IDENTIFICATION 'Insurance Repository Name' x2) emit NULL and are counted as refused rather than carrying a code where a label belongs. If a decode master is in fact available, 3 label attributes stay empty until the var is flipped.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Set dbt var mxh3_reference_decode_available to true (one line in dbt_project.yml), or pass --vars on the run.

builder_decisions.decision_note: The reference_decode GATE is scoped to the 3 blocks carrying build_directive, NOT to all 59 blocks whose transformation_kind is 'reference_decode'. The directive population is defined by the directive field; transformation_kind is a description of the mapping, not an instruction.
builder_decisions.cost_note: 56 blocks assert a code->decode transformation and are built WITHOUT the gate, so they load the mapped value as-is. If the mapper intended all 59 to be gated, 56 label attributes receive coded values. This is why the figure is reported with BOTH matchers rather than one.

builder_decisions.decision_note: The 45 surrogate-backed child-key components are emitted in the quarantine layer under a column named <LEG>__UNSTABLE_SURROGATE, NOT under the model's declared child-key column, and the quarantine models are emitted disabled. A column that is not spelled like the declared child key cannot be wired into a satellite by accident.
builder_decisions.cost_note: The 7 ratified Multi-Active SCD2 satellites carry NO history from these 45 blocks. That loss is deliberate and visible in the emitted SQL; it is not a source gap and must not be reported as one.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Set QUARANTINE_EMIT_DECLARED_NAME = True in this module -- which re-enables the duplicate-row defect the directive exists to prevent.

builder_decisions.decision_note: 'Last EMI Paid Date' and 'Outstanding Loan Amount' are built ONLY on the ratified SAT_CLAIM_BENEFIT_HEAD and suppressed on OPUS's placeholder SAT_CLAIM_COVER_SECTION_ASSESSMENT, which is absent from data_7.js entirely. Where data_7.js speaks, the model wins.
builder_decisions.cost_note: Splits a coherent 23-column OPUS assessment block for 2 columns of overlap; the remaining 21 columns stay on the placeholder and the block must be reassembled by hand to be read as a whole. Cheap to reverse -- it is an attribute routing entry, not a key.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Remove the 2 entries from ATTRIBUTE_ROUTING_SUPPRESS in this module.

builder_decisions.decision_note: SAT_CLAIM_STATUS_TRANSITION is ABSENT from data_7.js, so it is built on the augmented (unratified) track as a multi-active satellite with the caller-ratified child key 'Status Code | Transition Date' and a union of SEVEN attributes -- 'Transition Actor User Reference' and 'Transition Performed By Reference' are ONE fact fed from both sides, not two.
builder_decisions.cost_note: If the two names are in fact different facts, one column carries two meanings and separating them later is a satellite re-grain. The directive states they are the same fact; this build follows it.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Remove the pair from ATTRIBUTE_UNION_ALIASES in this module.

builder_decisions.decision_note: A '>>' / LCA cross descends into another branch and can match N rows per source row. The resolver exposes the crossed value ONLY when it matches exactly one row, and always exposes the match COUNT beside it; rows with N>1 are diverted to the reject log.
builder_decisions.cost_note: Where a cross is genuinely 1:N the value is NULL rather than an arbitrary pick, so those rows lose the key and are counted as rejects instead of silently keeping one branch's value. A fallback that guesses converts a loud gap into a silent corruption, which is why the NULL is preferred.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Set CROSS_REQUIRE_UNIQUE = False in this module (restores arbitrary pick semantics -- not recommended).

builder_decisions.decision_note: The 16 VIEW_COLLECTIONS_ADDITIONAL_DETAILS blocks whose resolved_key tier is 'unresolved' and which carry no expression are built with NO key: every row is diverted to the reject log carrying the declared source gap. Three candidate keys were considered and rejected by the mapper; inventing a fourth is not the builder's call (s5.7).
builder_decisions.cost_note: HUB_FINANCIAL_TRANSACTION receives nothing from that view, and 16 columns reach no satellite. Visible as a counted reject, not as an absent model.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Supply an expression in the map; this build will not synthesise one.

builder_decisions.decision_note: SRM-COVERGRAIN's 35 blocks on 2 views are BUILT as mapped (s5.7 -- the builder does not correct the mapping), with a per-anchor row count emitted beside the key so an N>1 fan-in is counted and diverted rather than silently keeping one arbitrary cover's values.
builder_decisions.cost_note: If the N rows per claim do carry differing values, those rows are rejected rather than loaded, so the satellite is EMPTY for those claims instead of wrong. Needs executed data to settle; invisible to check_collapse either way.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Set COVERGRAIN_DIVERT_FANOUT = False in this module.

builder_decisions.decision_note: resolved_on_view is NOT trusted. Membership is re-derived per row against the row's OWN view from 00_tables_index.json, and a brace token is read as a COALESCE LADDER of alternatives: a rung absent from the view is pruned, and only a leg with NO surviving rung is refused.
builder_decisions.cost_note: Under this matcher 1 component disagrees with its own flag: SAT_POLICY_COVERAGE_SCHEDULE 'Coverage Reference' = '{ADDEDCOVERS element}' on MEMBERS_MEMBER_DETAILS_PIVOT_VW, whose token contains a SPACE and so names no column. That block is REFUSED, not renamed. A ladder-blind matcher would instead have accused 246 components.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Set TRUST_RESOLVED_ON_VIEW = True in this module -- which emits a column that does not exist.

builder_decisions.decision_note: A 'spine:<TABLE>.<COLUMN>' rung inside a child-key value is DISPLAY ONLY and is never parsed as SQL. The displayed form names the CONCEPT; the mechanism is re-derived from the graph. All 199 occurrences name MEMBERS_PARTY.PARTY_CODE, which the graph shows is a SIBLING of the row's view in 198 of 199 cases -- so these are LCA crosses, not climbs.
builder_decisions.cost_note: The one remaining form, 'spine:ROLE' on SAT_LNK_POLICY_PARTY_ROLE, names no table in the index at all and is REFUSED rather than guessed at.
builder_decisions.overrule_note: Supply the table in the map's resolved_key; the display form will not be promoted to executable here.
